palette.$description: Primitive ramps. Manus ships Tailwind 3 without its colour palette and declares only semantic variables, so these ramps are assembled from the values those variables hold (Derived): the neutral ramp from every grey in the light and dark blocks, and one ramp per accent palette the user can pick. Semantic tokens do not alias them; use them to see the steps Manus actually uses.

space.$description: Keys are pixel values. Manus writes spacing as Tailwind classes on a 4px base (a class step n is n x 4px, so gap-2 is 8px), with the 2px half steps it leans on in dense rows and a few arbitrary values (1, 7, 10 and 14px). Steps used on fewer than 20 elements are left out (they are in raw/css-rules.json). Component paddings that are not on the scale come from the density tokens (density.*: 10px menu rows, 9px nav items).
